new_value: C DAO prefix-authorization gate ported with sub-/128 generalized semantics (resolution (b), cross-ref l327). DESIGN: (1) Delegation table in rpl_dao_process.c implements the free-function API already declared in rpl_routing.h (lichen_rpl_prefix_delegate/revoke/delegation_authorizes/delegations_reset, CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_MAX_PREFIX_DELEGATIONS=64): static file-scope storage, no malloc, operator-seeded process-lifetime state, canonicalizing + idempotent delegate, exact-match authorizes (no sub/aggregate inheritance), fail-closed on NULL//0/>128 (ERR_INVALID) and capacity (ERR_FULL). Gate reads the table under the DAO manager mutex; threading contract documented (mirrors Rust &mut exclusivity; Rust keys by pubkey, C by verified DAO Source Address per header note). (2) dao_targets_match_origin replaced by dao_targets_authorized: every Target canonicalized per spec/05-routing.md 8.7.1 (reserved flags + bits beyond Prefix Length ignored), self-/128 allowed, else exact delegation required; /0, truncated bodies, prefix_len>128, and targetless DAOs fail closed; runs in process_dao BEFORE extract/slot/sequence/graph/rebuild so denials are zero-mutation. (3) extract_updates Target parsing generalized to prefix_len 1..=128 with >=ceil(prefix_len/8) octets, canonicalized; /0 rejected. (4) WIRE LAYER: validate_dao_options in messages.c enforced the pre-generalized profile (Target data_len==18, flags==0) which rejected generalized bodies before the gate; relaxed to mirror Rust is_generalized_target_body (len>=2, plen<=128, len-2>=ceil(plen/8), flags ignored) - rpl_messages.h doc comments updated; lichen_rpl_target_parse left untouched (test-vector-pinned, no production caller after this change). PARITY with rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs: self-/128 allow+Applied, foreign /128 deny, unauth/absent-origin fail-closed (pre-existing matrix, now 4 rows counted as passes); foreign /64 + /0 gate-denied pre-mutation (memcmp of whole root_state incl. workspace); truncated /64, plen 129, 1-byte target body, targetless all rejected; delegation API fail-closed (/0, /129, exact-match /63+/72+/56, foreign-origin binding, non-canonical lookup denied, idempotent re-delegate, 64 capacity + 65th ERR_FULL + idempotent at capacity, revoke canonical + absent no-op, reset); delegated /64 end-to-end Applied with canonical snapshot (active, seq verified) and route installed, plus delegated foreign /128 Applied; non-canonical /64 body (extra 0xff host bytes) canonicalized end-to-end; reserved-flags /128 accepted (8.7.1 receivers-ignore); /127 boundary encoding (low bit ignored) installed as canonical /127; /63 vs /64 delegation denied pre-mutation. EVIDENCE: lichen/tests/rpl_dao_auth 9/9 rows passed under ASan+UBSan (cmake 3.31.3, Apple clang, -Werror); regression suites rpl_messages, rpl_dao_sequence, rpl_dis, rpl_dodag, rpl_short_assignment all 100% pass (messages.c validator touched); cppcheck on rpl_dao_process.c: zero new findings vs HEAD baseline (fixed pre-existing parent_slot variableScope; remaining constParameterPointer nit pre-existing and unsound - writes go through copied inner pointers); clang-tidy misc-use-internal-linkage failures reproduced identically on HEAD = known include-path env gap. Follow-up filed: project-LICHEN-worker6-8t7x (rebuild_routes installs sub-/128 targets as host-style routes; needs add_prefix/egress + managed-prefix reconciliation).
